chapters.title: Manager-Worker: the fan and the tape
chapters.blurb: A manager fans one question out to a fixed trio of specialists, records every spawn on its stream, and is relit one wake at a time until the synthesis.

chapters.title: Map-Reduce: one worker per chunk
chapters.blurb: The input decides the fan: a document shatters into chunks, one worker each, wakes land out of order, and a single reduce merges them.

chapters.title: Pipeline: one stage per wake
chapters.blurb: A payload metamorphoses through preprocessor, analyzer, and synthesizer while a forward-only state machine advances one stage per wake.

chapters.title: Dispatcher: classify and route
chapters.blurb: A railroad switch for messages: the model picks a specialist type per request, spawns it on demand, and forwards each answer home on a wake.

chapters.title: The map, and the crash test
chapters.blurb: All four patterns on one map, cut by two questions — then a blackout kills every process, and the surviving stream tapes resume every machine.
